thread:
maria: Quick heads-up — planning a micro-spiral canary for \"quant-scheduler\" rollout today 18:30 UTC. Goal: validate burst handling + KV cache under a 1%→5%→25%→75% ladder. Need deploy owner + smoke owner + rollback ready. Anyone volunteer?

sam: I can own deploy. Will be on call. :hand: 

lee: I'll take smoke checks and watch latency p95 and error rate. Which cohorts are we doing first?

maria: initial cohort = eu-west (mapped to ~1% global), then us-east, then apac. Percent ladder: 1, 5, 25, 75. Hold 5m between steps, extend to 10m if p95 spikes >50ms over baseline or errors >0.5%. Rollback threshold: error rate >=0.5% OR token-gen p95 +30%.

ali: I'll prep a short smoke script. Posting expected checks in a sec.

ali: ```\ncurl -s -X POST -H \"Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY\" \"https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate\" -d '{"model":"quant-scheduler-v2","input":"healthcheck"}' \n# expect HTTP 200 and JSON with latency < 300ms\n```

devex: I'll sanity the telemetry and confirm dashboards+traces are hooked to the canary route. Also will pin model to v2 for the canary traffic.

deploy-bot: Dry run for quant-scheduler-v2 completed: no immediate config errors. :white_check_mark: 

ops-bot: Label created: canary-spiral-3325

sam: ETA 18:30 UTC. I will push canary and monitor. Who's on rollback if needed?

lee: If we need rollback, I can execute rollback and coordinate with infra. Confirm automatic fallback policies are enabled.

maria: Quick checklist before greenlight: 1) smoke script in ops-runbook, 2) alerts for p95 + error rate, 3) SLO mute window if needed, 4) stakeholders pinged.

sam: all set. I'll escalate to oncall if errors >1% sustained for 5m.

ali: smoke script posted to #eng-sre with command and expected outputs. Link: https://go.internal/ops-smoke/quant-scheduler-canary (internal).

devex: small ask — enable kernel_fallback=true for the canary route to avoid kernel mismatch on older GPUs; safer for initial ramp.

sam: set kernel_fallback=true in canary flags.

maria: OK pushing at 18:31 UTC now. Please ack when you see first 1% traffic diverted.

lee: seeing initial 1% diverted, p95 +5ms, errors 0.02% — looks good. :thumbsup: 

sam: moved to 5% at 18:37. watching.

lee: 5% stable, p95 +12ms, errors 0.25% — under thresholds.

maria: proceeding to 25% in 6m; will hold 10m if p95 jumps.

sam: 25% done, saw a spike to +60ms at ~2m mark but recovered to +20ms. errors 0.4% — still under rollback thresholds. Holding.

lee: noted elevated CPU on node-pool-g4dn-3; autoscale kicked in, no token drops observed.

ali: ran the full smoke suite at 25% — sample generation outputs look ok, no regression on our small eval set.

maria: proceeding to 75% in 8m. Call if anything weird.

sam: pushed 75%. observed transient timeouts for ~30s but retries recovered. Metrics trending stable post-retry.

lee: p95 settled to +18ms, errors 0.1%. All checks green. Removing canary flag and scheduling full rollout tomorrow morning.

maria: thanks all — I'll update ops-runbook with notes + rollback play and tag stakeholders.

sam: :rocket: Great job, team.
